en: I am very happy to meet you.
My name is Xiaoyu, and you?
I am very well, and you?

pinyin: wǒ cóng Lúndūn lái, nǐ ne?

I can speak a little Chinese.

pinyin: wǒ huì shuō zhōngwén hé yīngyǔ.

I can speak a little Japanese.
Xiaoyu can speak a little Japanese.

Great! I am a designer too.
I work at a design company.

tā de fànguǎn jiào shénme míngzi?

zhè shì wǒ de diànhuà hàomǎ.

I would like to see a film.

pinyin: wǒ yào qù fànguǎn chī jiǎozi.

en: Tomorrow I am going to the office to work.
What do you want to eat?
The restaurant has a lot of people.
I want to ask the teacher.
She has a lot of friends.

Mǎkè, nǐ měitiān jǐ diǎn qǐchuáng?
en: Mark, what time do you get up every day?

pinyin: Mǎkè, zhè shì wǒ biǎogē, Chénmíng.
en: Mark, this is my cousin, Chen Ming.
Xiaoyu, how old are you this year?

hanzi: 很少下雪，可是常常下雨。都是小雨！
pinyin: hěn shǎo xiàxuě, kěshì chángcháng xiàyǔ. dōu shì Xiǎoyǔ!
en: Hardly ever, but it rains a lot. Always light rain, xiǎoyǔ!

pinyin: Xiǎoyǔ, wǒmen jiā gè wēixìn ba!
en: Xiaoyu, let's add each other on WeChat!

hanzi: 陈明，你的饭馆有几个厨师？
pinyin: Chénmíng, nǐ de fànguǎn yǒu jǐ gè chúshī?
en: Chen Ming, how many chefs are there at your restaurant?

hanzi: 六块五。陈明感冒了？他就是太累了！
pinyin: liù kuài wǔ. Chénmíng gǎnmào le? tā jiù shì tài lèi le!
en: Six fifty. Chen Ming's got a cold? He's just worn out!

hanzi: 陈明，你怎么了？哪儿不舒服？
pinyin: Chénmíng, nǐ zěnmele? nǎr bù shūfu?
en: Chen Ming, what's the matter? Are you not well?

hanzi: 我和朵朵在家做了几个北京菜，还看了一个电影。
pinyin: wǒ hé Duǒduo zài jiā zuò le jǐ gè běijīng cài, hái kàn le yī gè diànyǐng.
en: Duoduo and I cooked a few Beijing dishes at home, and watched a film.

hanzi: 你好！我叫朵朵。你叫什么名字？
pinyin: nǐhǎo! wǒ jiào Duǒduo. nǐ jiào shénme míngzi?
en: Hi! I'm Duoduo. What's your name?

hanzi: 明天我们想带朵朵去大英博物馆。离这儿远吗？
pinyin: míngtiān wǒmen xiǎng dài Duǒduo qù Dàyīngbówùguǎn. lí zhèr yuǎn ma?
en: Tomorrow we'd like to take Duoduo to the British Museum. Is it far from here?

pinyin: nǐmen hǎo! xiǎng hē diǎnr shénme?
en: Hello, you two! What would you like?

hanzi: 会！我会说英语和中文。你会说中文吗？
pinyin: huì! wǒ huì shuō yīngyǔ hé zhōngwén. nǐ huì shuō zhōngwén ma?
en: Yes! I speak English and Chinese. Can you speak Chinese?
What time do you go to bed?

hanzi: 零七七零零，九零零，四六一？
pinyin: líng qīqī línglíng, jiǔ línglíng, sìliù yī?

hanzi: 我喜欢做饭，也喜欢逛市场。你有什么爱好？
pinyin: wǒ xǐhuan zuòfàn, yě xǐhuan guàng shìchǎng. nǐ yǒu shénme àihào?
en: I like cooking, and I like wandering round markets. What are your hobbies?

pinyin: duì, wǒ xìng Lín. nǐ xìng shénme?
en: Yes, my surname is Lin. What's your surname?

hanzi: 那是你的饭馆？太好了！你的饭馆叫什么名字？
pinyin: nà shì nǐ de fànguǎn? tàihǎole! nǐ de fànguǎn jiào shénme míngzi?
en: That's yours? Great! What's it called?

pinyin: dà bēi. Mǎkè, nǐ hē nǎge?
en: Large. Mark, which one are you having?

hanzi: 不太冷，没有北京那么冷。伦敦冬天常常下雪吗？
pinyin: bù tài lěng, méiyǒu běijīng nàme lěng. lúndūn dōngtiān chángcháng xiàxuě ma?
en: Not very. Not as cold as Beijing. Does it snow much in London in winter?

hanzi: 真的吗？那我也要送她一件礼物。送什么好呢？
pinyin: zhēnde ma? nà wǒ yě yào sòng tā yī jiàn lǐwù. sòng shénme hǎo ne?
en: Really? Then I want to get her a present too. What should I give her?

pinyin: nǐhǎo! qǐngwèn, nǐ shì Mǎkè ma?
en: Hello! Excuse me, are you Mark?

hanzi: 马克，上个周末你做了什么？
pinyin: Mǎkè, shàng gè zhōumò nǐ zuò le shénme?
en: Mark, what did you do last weekend?
What about mooncakes? How many boxes?

pinyin: nà xīngqītiān ne? nǐ yǒukòng ma?
en: What about Sunday, then? Are you free?
What time do you finish work?

hanzi: 好啊！表哥，你也一起去吧？
pinyin: hǎo a! biǎogē, nǐ yě yīqǐ qù ba?
en: Sure! You'll come too, won't you, cousin?

pinyin: Chénmíng ne? tā zài zuòfàn ma?
en: What about Chen Ming? Is he cooking?

pinyin: qǐngwèn, zhè shì shéi de shǒujī?
en: Excuse me, whose phone is this?
Mark, will you have a coffee?

hanzi: 差五分三点！电影已经开始了，快走吧！
pinyin: chà wǔ fēn sān diǎn! diànyǐng yǐjīng kāishǐ le, kuài zǒu ba!
en: Five to three! The film's already started. Come on, quick!

hanzi: 星期六你有空吗？我们一起去逛博罗市场吧！
pinyin: xīngqī liù nǐ yǒukòng ma? wǒmen yīqǐ qù guàng Bóluóshìchǎng ba!
en: Are you free on Saturday? Let's go to Borough Market!

pinyin: nà wǒmen yīqǐ kāichē qù ba!
en: Then let's all drive there together!

hanzi: 妈妈，我们北京人也很热情啊！来，先吃饺子吧！
pinyin: māma, wǒmen běijīng rén yě hěn rèqíng a! lái, xiān chī jiǎozi ba!
en: Mum, we Beijingers are friendly too! Now, have some dumplings first!

hanzi: 我有车，可是没去过牛津。我在伦敦住了十年，还没去过！
pinyin: wǒ yǒu chē, kěshì méi qù guo Niújīn. wǒ zài lúndūn zhù le shí nián, hái méi qù guo!
en: I've got a car, but I've never been. Ten years in London and I still haven't been!
I've got a headache, and a sore throat.

hanzi: 我去过好几次。牛津很漂亮！
pinyin: wǒ qù guo hǎojǐ cì. Niújīn hěn piàoliang!
en: I've been quite a few times. Oxford's beautiful!

hanzi: 我们在伦敦住了很多年，还不认识路！
pinyin: wǒmen zài lúndūn zhù le hěnduō nián, hái bù rènshi lù!
en: All these years in London, and we still don't know the way!

hanzi: 星期六？不好意思，星期六饭馆很忙，我要工作。
pinyin: xīngqī liù? bùhǎoyìsi, xīngqī liù fànguǎn hěn máng, wǒ yào gōngzuò.
en: Saturday? Sorry, Saturday's busy at the restaurant. I have to work.

hanzi: 十一点。睡觉以前，我喜欢看一点儿书。
pinyin: shí yī diǎn. shuìjiào yǐqián, wǒ xǐhuan kàn yīdiǎnr shū.
en: Eleven. Before bed I like to read a bit.

pinyin: ránhòu zài wǎng qián zǒu yī bǎi mǐ, jiù dào le.
en: Then walk on another hundred metres, and you're there.

pinyin: zhēnde ma? wǒ zài dàxué xué shèjì!

pinyin: wǒ měitiān zuò gōngjiāochē qù xuéxiào, bù zuò dìtiě.

pinyin: bùxíng, xīngqī liù fànguǎn hěn máng, wǒ děi gōngzuò.

pinyin: kuài lái chī dàngāo ba! hái yǒu yuèbǐng!
en: Come and have some cake! There are mooncakes too!

pinyin: wǒ hěn xǐhuan yīnyuè. wǒ xǐhuan chànggē, yě xǐhuan tán jítā.
en: I love music. I like singing, and playing the guitar.

pinyin: wǒ mǎi le yīxiē miànbāo hé shuǐguǒ, Chénmíng mǎi le hěnduō cài.
en: I bought some bread and fruit, and Chen Ming bought loads of vegetables.

pinyin: fànguǎn hái yǒu liǎng gè chúshī ne! nǐ shì lǎobǎn, nǐ děi huí jiā shuìjiào!
en: There are two other chefs! You're the boss. You have to go home to bed!

hanzi: 那今年我们在伦敦一起过！
pinyin: nà jīnnián wǒmen zài lúndūn yīqǐ guò!
en: Then this year we'll celebrate together in London!

hanzi: 没事儿，就是感冒。多喝热水就好了。
pinyin: méishìr, jiù shì gǎnmào. duō hē rèshuǐ jiù hǎo le.
en: It's nothing, just a cold. I'll drink lots of hot water and be fine.

pinyin: dàjiā hǎo! jīntiān shì zhōngqiūjié, zhù dàjiā zhōngqiūjié kuàilè!
